title: Commanders rally for 22-20 Upset of Bengals
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: Even as the Cincinnati Bengals offense was struggling relative to its lofty expectations, their game with the Washington Commanders to wrap up Week 11 never really seemed in doubt.
